title: 上海高考翻译背诵-60-26一模闵行

items.zh: 我的曾祖母现在依然保留着使用手帕的习惯。
items.en: My great-grandmother still sticks to the habit of using handkerchiefs.

items.zh: 你收集的资料越充分，报告就越有说服力。
items.en: The more sufficient materials you collect, the mor persuasive the report will be.

items.zh: 凭借过硬的专业素养，面试后，多家研发机构向这位毕业生伸出了橄榄枝。
items.en: Thanks to his solid professional expertise, the graduate has received unsolicited offers from multiple research and development institutes since the interview.

items.zh: 爱深厚的农耕文化的与生态旅游资源驱动，这座偏远村庄如今已蜕变为宜居宜游的美丽乡村。
items.en: Fueled by profound agricultural culture and eco-tourism resources, the remote village has now transformed into a beautiful and livable tourist-friendly destination.
